argv:
import copy, hashlib, json, shutil; from pathlib import Path
store = Path("<store>")
root = store / "artifacts/20261117-sti108-baseline"
source = json.loads((store / "logs/sti-108-supplemental-source-hashes.log").read_text())
for item in source["files"]:
    path = root / item["path"]
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    if path.stat().st_size != item["size"] or digest != item["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Supplemental artifact mismatch: " + item["path"])
original = json.loads((root / "deploy/spdx/qemuarm64/recipes/recipe-libwebsockets.spdx.json").read_text())
normalized = json.loads((root / "scans/libwebsockets-reference-type-normalized.spdx.json").read_text())
restored = copy.deepcopy(normalized)
restored["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"] = original["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"]
if restored != original:
    raise RuntimeError("The CPE diagnostic changed more than the declared reference-type field")
raw = json.loads((root / "scans/baseline-library-native-all-grype.json").read_text())
fixed = json.loads((root / "scans/baseline-library-normalized-grype.json").read_text())
a = copy.deepcopy(raw["descriptor"]["configuration"])
b = copy.deepcopy(fixed["descriptor"]["configuration"])
a.pop("file")
b.pop("file")
if a != b or raw["matches"] or len(fixed["matches"]) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Controlled CPE diagnostic did not preserve configuration or expected observed counts")
if fixed["matches"][0]["vulnerability"]["id"] != "CVE-2025-1866":
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected diagnostic finding")
report = {"status": "verified", "file_count": len(source["files"]), "component_source_commit": source["component_source_commit"], "component_worktree_clean": source["component_worktree_clean"], "existing_component_patch_order": source["existing_component_patch_order"], "controlled_scanner_configuration_equal_except_output_path": True, "diagnostic_semantic_changes": ["/packages/0/externalRefs/0/referenceType"], "source_inventory_sha256": hashlib.sha256((store / "logs/sti-108-supplemental-source-hashes.log").read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "linux_filesystem_available_bytes": source["linux_filesystem_available_bytes"], "host_free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(root).free}
with (store / "runs/sti-108-supplemental-integrity.json").open("x") as output:
    json.dump(report, output, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
